jobs.title: Bitovi: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://bitovi.com

JOIN OUR TEAM!

Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 

WHO YOU ARE

You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

  • Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes
  • Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag
  • Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus
  • Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)
  • Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads
  • A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems
  • Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime
  • A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery
  • Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)
  • Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications
  • Database schema design and development expertise

Other skills we value

Temporal depth

  • Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud
  • Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations
  • Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)
  • Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

Kafka & event streaming depth

  • Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)
  • Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)
  • Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores
  • Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

Platform / DevOps depth

  • Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams
  • GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar
  • Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs
  • Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)
  • Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)
  • EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

General

  • Interest in working across multiple backend languages
  • Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)
  • API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)
  • AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)
  • Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

WHO WE ARE

Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 

BENEFITS WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity
  • Completely remote work with flexible hours
  • 401(k) matching
  • 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 

HOW TO APPLY

Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link. 

 

OTHER 

Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters. 

ID Verification required if invited to an interview.

All job offers are contingent on passing a background check. 

Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote-US

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.

 

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Data Engineer to define and evolve the architecture, engineering standards, and operating model for our enterprise data platform.

This role is for a technical leader who excels at complex system design: translating business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data products. The Principal Data Engineer will lead critical architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, governance, observability, and consumption, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, and pragmatic best practices.

You will work across engineering, analytics, platform, security, and business stakeholders to create systems that make trusted data accessible, timely, and actionable at scale.

 

What You’ll Do

Lead Data Architecture and System Design

  • Own the technical vision and architecture for scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms and pipelines.
  • Design end-to-end data systems spanning batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data modeling, storage, orchestration, serving layers, and consumption patterns.
  • Make and document high-quality architecture decisions, including tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, scalability, latency, security, maintainability, and cost.
  • Define reusable architectural patterns for common data engineering challenges, including CDC, event-driven data flows, schema evolution, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and multi-tenant or domain-oriented data models.
  • Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications.
  • Lead technical design reviews for high-impact initiatives and provide clear, constructive direction on implementation approaches.
  • Identify architectural risks early and drive plans to mitigate technical debt, single points of failure, data inconsistency, and operational fragility.

Set Engineering Standards and Best Practices

  • Establish and continuously improve standards for data engineering development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle management.
  • Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion.
  • Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation.
  • Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Develop practical engineering guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality, trust, or operational excellence.
  • Drive adoption of well-defined SLIs, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident learning practices for critical data products.

Drive Technical Decision-Making

  • Serve as a trusted technical authority for complex, cross-functional decisions involving data architecture, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering investments.
  • Facilitate technical discussions that turn ambiguous requirements into durable, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, platform technologies, and vendor capabilities using clear criteria and documented recommendations.
  • Align architecture decisions with organizational priorities, business outcomes, data strategy, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams.
  • Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward.

Build and Improve Data Products

  • Lead the design and development of high-value, production-grade data pipelines, datasets, and platform capabilities.
  • Partner with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to deliver well-modeled, discoverable, and trustworthy data products.
  • Optimize data systems for reliability, usability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms, consolidation of fragmented pipelines, and reduction of manual operational processes.
  • Ensure data products are designed with clear ownership, documentation, lineage, quality expectations, and support models.

Mentor and Multiply Engineering Excellence

  • Mentor data engineers at all levels, with a particular focus on growing senior engineers into strong technical leaders.
  • Provide practical coaching on system design, data modeling, debugging, performance tuning, code quality, and production operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership.
  • Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles.

 

What you bring

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products.
  • Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems.
  • Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar.
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security.
  • Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization.

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling.
  • Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains.
  • Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations.
  • Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations.

Leadership Competencies

  • Systems thinker: Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes.
  • Pragmatic architect: Balances ideal-state architecture with incremental delivery and operational realities.
  • Technical judgment: Makes clear recommendations amid ambiguity and communicates tradeoffs transparently.
  • Builder and operator: Designs for production from the beginning, including reliability, security, observability, and supportability.
  • Mentor and multiplier: Develops others and creates scalable mechanisms for technical excellence.
  • Collaborative influencer: Builds alignment across engineering, analytics, security, product, and business teams.

Our Technology Stack

  • Languages & Databases: Python, SQL, MySQL, NoSQL databases
  • Orchestration & Transformation: Airflow, dbt

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

About the team

The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

About the role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

Things you will do

Build and deliver AI products

  • Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.
  • Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.
  • Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.

Shape our AI engineering practice

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.  Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

jobs.title: Typeform: Senior AI Engineer - US
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the ET timezone in the US.

About the team

The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

About the role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

Things you will do

Build and deliver AI products

  • Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.
  • Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.
  • Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.
  • Turn prototypes into reliable production systems with clear measures of performance and quality.
  • Explore new ways for customers to collect, understand, and act on information using AI.

Build scalable AI systems

  • Design and operate machine learning services and workflows using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.
  • Build reliable pipelines for batch and real time processing using technologies such as Kafka and Airflow.
  • Design solutions using vector databases to support retrieval, recommendations, personalisation, and semantic search.
  • Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AI systems.

Evaluate and improve AI quality

  • Build automated evaluation pipelines for generative AI applications, including the conversational and analytical capabilities behind Research Flow.
  • Develop benchmarks that measure accuracy, relevance, reliability, fairness, latency, and cost.
  • Evaluate retrieval strategies, including chunking, embeddings, context selection, and reranking.
  • Monitor AI systems in production and identify opportunities to improve their quality and performance.
  • Create safeguards that reduce unexpected behaviour and protect customer data.

Shape our AI engineering practice

  • Establish reusable patterns and technical standards for building, evaluating, and releasing AI systems.
  • Help teams make informed decisions about models, frameworks, infrastructure, performance, and cost.
  • Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.
  • Share technical knowledge and support the development of other engineers.
  • Keep up with relevant AI research, tools, and engineering practices, applying what is useful to Typeform.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to connect AI investments with customer and business needs.
  • Work with Data Scientists to turn experiments and models into reliable production services.
  • Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.
  • Contribute to technical planning and help shape the direction of AI across Typeform.

What you bring

  • At least four years of experience building and deploying machine learning or AI systems in production.
  • Strong Python and software engineering skills.
  • Experience building production services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI.
  • Practical experience developing generative AI applications using large language models, RAG, tool use, or agentic systems.
  • Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
  • A strong understanding of enterprise RAG systems, including chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, and monitoring.
  • Experience creating automated evaluations for generative AI applications.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and continuous integration and deployment practices.
  • Experience using services such as AWS SageMaker or AWS Bedrock.
  • Experience with Kafka, vector databases, or other technologies used for real time and high dimensional data processing.
  • Experience managing machine learning workflows using MLflow.
  • Experience monitoring production systems with tools such as Datadog or OpenSearch.
  • The ability to balance quality, speed, reliability, scalability, and cost when making technical decisions.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

Extra awesome

  • Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Argo Workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Spark, Snowflake, or other data processing technologies.
  • Experience building systems that combine structured data, unstructured data, and generative AI.
  • Experience with AI security, privacy, responsible AI, prompt injection protection, or data leakage prevention.
  • Experience improving the latency and cost of AI systems operating at scale.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

jobs.title: ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Applied AI Engineer - Entity Agents
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.

Senior Applied AI Engineer, Entity Agents

ZoomInfo | Product | Core Data

About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute, you’ll make things happen, fast.

The Opportunity

ZoomInfo’s Core Data team builds the company and contact data behind the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform: hundreds of millions of records, resolved to the right entity, kept accurate, and delivered to more than 35,000 customers.

The way that data is produced is changing. For years it came from deterministic pipelines: many sources, weighted and decayed, one winner per attribute. Core Data is now moving to AI-native data management, where an agent pursues the evidence for an entity, decides every attribute over all of it, and records why. The company and contact agents already exist as working, measured prototypes. What does not exist yet is the machinery that runs them at production volume, proves every version before it ships, and lets researchers and product managers operate them without an engineer in the loop.

We are hiring a Senior Applied AI Engineer to build and own that machinery. You will complete the entity-agent pipeline, build the evidence adapters behind a single envelope, run the benchmark and golden-gate system on a schedule, build the review and batch tooling the team operates, and carry the agents onto ZoomInfo’s Agentic Platform. You will work with the Principal AI Engineer who owns the benchmark harness and productionization, the product manager who owns evaluation and policy, and the company and person engineering teams that own the pipelines the agents feed. You will not be the only person who can do this work; you will be the second, so that neither of you is a single point of failure.

This is a role for someone who has shipped LLM systems in production with evaluations, builds platform for other people to operate, and can work inside a large-scale data pipeline. You should be as comfortable writing an adapter with a replayable store and a kill switch as you are reading a miss analysis with a product manager, and you should like that the prototype you take to production was built by a PM who commits code.

What You’ll Do

Run the benchmark and golden-gate system. Move judge runs, golden-gate results, arms scorecards, and cost per record from a laptop to a scheduled system against staging. Every agent version is gated automatically, with variance and drift tracked per release. The evaluation product manager sets the thresholds; you make them enforceable.

Complete the entity-agent pipeline. Build the stages that do not exist yet: enricher fan-out, location sets, and hierarchy batch files. Migrate the classifiers to the shared runner with the Principal AI Engineer so they run at production scale. Measure throughput and unit cost per stage on named cohorts, so the cost model comes from instrumentation rather than estimates.

Build the evidence adapters. Registries, live web, mail-tenant signals, and external research vendors all sit behind one envelope with a replayable vendor store, measured lift per shape, a per-vendor kill switch, and at least two sources per shape. Vendors are swappable by design.

Deploy onto the ZoomInfo Agentic Platform. Carry the company and contact agents through the production plan onto ZAP, build the ingest adapter side (envelope to match service and bulk intake), and keep a rollback path per version. Keep the DOH implementation and the platform implementation upgraded in lockstep, enforced by tooling.

Make the loop self-service. Build the review queue, tagging tools, blast-radius viewer, and batch runners that researchers and product managers use without an engineer. Measure review yield and golden-record production.

Keep the agent surfaces alive. Own the health and deployment of the company classifier, contact classifier, agents hub, and judge platform inside our internal tooling, so the team’s iteration cycle never waits on one person.

Instrument everything. Cost per call, per row, per stage; quality per version; alerts before a human notices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years shipping LLM-based systems to production: agent loops, tool use, retrieval, structured output, and the evaluation harness that proved them
  • Strong Python and TypeScript, and comfort across an API layer, a batch runner, and a small web UI for internal users
  • Experience building platform others operate: adapters, runners, queues, or internal tools designed for replay, idempotency, and observability
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines and entity resolution: how records move through ingestion, matching, and serving, and what a false merge costs versus a missed match
  • A track record of taking a prototype to production without losing what the prototype proved, treating test sets and benchmarks as the contract
  • Instrumentation by default: you know the cost and latency budget of every system you have shipped
  • Strong bias for action and the tenacity to find an endpoint owner, get a decision, and unblock a runner in a fast-moving, distributed organization

Preferred

  • Experience with B2B company or contact data, identity or registry data, or entity resolution at scale
  • Experience with Claude or comparable frontier models, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses
  • Experience deploying agents onto an internal agent platform or orchestration layer
  • Background at an AI-native startup, a forward-deployed or applied AI team, or a data infrastructure company

Who You Are

A builder who ships. You pick the boring technology when it wins and you would rather have a running adapter than a design doc.

An evaluator by instinct. You do not release a version without a test set, a threshold, and a number for what it costs.

A platform thinker. You build things that other people run, and you design for the day the vendor goes down.

Comfortable in the data. You can read a pipeline, reason about matching, and explain why a wrong merge is worse than a missed one.

Tenacious. ZoomInfo is fast, distributed, and messy. You go find the people you need and drive the work to done.

One team. Honest, has the team’s back, celebrates wins and losses together.

The Environment

You report to the Senior Manager of Product for Core Data, with the Principal AI Engineer as your technical lead, and sit inside the Core and Global Data organization under the Chief Data Officer. Your day-to-day partners are the Principal AI Engineer, the product manager who owns evaluation and data policy, the Company and Person Data product managers, the research team that grades and rules, the agentic platform team, and company and person engineering. Expect interesting problems: how do you run a judge over a million records a day for cents, not dollars? How do you make a vendor replaceable without a rewrite? How do you let a researcher run a batch and rule on the misses without paging you?

About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.

ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.

In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits here.

$171,500—$269,500 USD

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.

ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information.

jobs.title: HYROS: Customer Success Manager – High-Touch Onboarding
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Delaware
URL: https://hyros.com/

About the Job

At HYROS, we help businesses understand exactly where their customers and revenue come from through advanced ad tracking and attribution.

We're looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager with 5+ years of experience to own high-touch onboarding and customer success for key customers.

This is not a purely relationship-focused CSM role. Onboarding at HYROS has a strong technical component. You'll need to understand how a customer's marketing and sales ecosystem works, help them connect the right platforms, troubleshoot setup issues, and make sure their tracking is working correctly.

Your goal is clear: help customers get set up correctly, reach value fast, trust their data, and use HYROS to make better business decisions.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll lead customer relationships, identify risks early, solve problems proactively, and be accountable for successful onboarding, adoption, and retention.

What You'll Own & What Success Looks Like

As a Customer Success Manager at HYROS, you'll be responsible for guiding customers through onboarding, helping them get real value from their data, and building strong relationships that support long-term retention.

Your performance will be measured across four key areas:

  1. Customer Retention: The percentage of customers you successfully retain within your assigned portfolio.

  2. Customer Portfolio: The number of customers you manage while maintaining a high standard of service and engagement.

  3. Onboarding & Activation: How effectively you guide customers through technical implementation, complete their setup, and help them start using HYROS.

  4. Customer Satisfaction: The quality of your customer relationships, feedback, and ability to resolve issues proactively.

What Success in This Role Looks Like

First 30 Days — Learning & First Customers

  • Understand HYROS, our onboarding playbooks, internal processes, and customer journey.

  • Become familiar with our tracking technology, integrations, and common implementation challenges.

  • Understand how platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, CRMs, and payment processors connect with HYROS.

  • Start hosting onboarding calls and guiding your first customers through their setup.

  • Learn how to troubleshoot common tracking, integration, and data validation issues.

First 60 Days — Building Independence

  • Confidently lead onboarding calls and guide customers through technical implementations.

  • Become comfortable helping customers install tracking scripts, configure integrations, validate events, and troubleshoot setup issues.

  • Independently manage your first customer portfolio and keep onboarding progress on track.

  • Identify potential setup or engagement risks early and take action before they become bigger problems.

  • Develop a strong understanding of how customers use HYROS data to improve their advertising decisions.

First 90 Days — Full Ownership

  • Take full ownership of your assigned customers, from onboarding through activation and ongoing adoption.

  • Independently handle most common technical onboarding challenges, knowing when deeper technical support is needed.

  • Run effective customer training sessions and explain complex tracking concepts in a simple, practical way.

  • Help customers understand their attribution data and turn it into actionable business decisions.

  • Proactively manage customer engagement, satisfaction, and retention risks.

  • Maintain strong relationships and consistently positive customer feedback.

First 180 Days — Consistent Performance

  • Independently manage a growing customer portfolio while maintaining a high standard of customer service.

  • Consistently deliver successful onboarding, strong adoption, and positive customer retention.

  • Become a trusted advisor who helps customers make better marketing and business decisions using HYROS.

  • Demonstrate strong technical confidence across common integrations, tracking setups, and troubleshooting scenarios.

  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency, customer experience, and retention.

  • Contribute to improving internal playbooks, processes, and best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of Customer Success experience, ideally in SaaS.

  • Experience managing high-touch or strategic customers.

  • Strong understanding of customer onboarding, adoption, and retention.

  • Comfort working in technical customer environments. You don't need to be a developer, but technical implementations shouldn't intimidate you.

  • Hands-on familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, or similar marketing and e-commerce platforms.

  • Comfortable understanding how websites, funnels, tracking scripts, integrations, pixels/events, and customer data connect at a practical level.

  • Able to troubleshoot logically, identify where a setup may be breaking, and clearly explain the solution to a customer.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex or technical topics simple.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

  • Comfortable using data and customer signals to prioritize and take action.

  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You don't wait for problems to become escalations.

Big Plus

  • Experience with marketing analytics, paid advertising, ad tracking, attribution, conversion tracking, e-commerce, or technical SaaS products.

We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.

What You Bring

jobs.title: Paid Ads Academy: Paid Ads Specialist
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA
URL: https://paidadscoaching.com/

The Paid Ads Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of Paid Ads Academy's own paid media, the campaigns that drive traffic and leads into our challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels. You take the targeting, budget, and testing plan the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets and run it: building campaigns, watching spend daily, and reporting on what is working across multiple platforms: Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, etc.

The Senior Paid Ads Coach owns strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds. You own execution: the builds, the daily optimizations inside those thresholds, the tracking hygiene, and the reporting that tells everyone the truth about what happened. A strategy is only as good as the account it runs in.

What makes this different from an agency seat is whose money it is. This is our budget, driving leads into the programs that fund the company. When cost per lead drifts, it is not a client conversation, it is our margin. We also teach paid ads for a living, which means our own accounts should be the strongest example of the work we put in front of students. You will be one of the people who makes that true.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Execution

  • Campaign Build & Launch: Build and launch paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, Spotify, ChatGPT, and YouTube for challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels, following the targeting, budget, and creative testing plan set by the Senior Paid Ads Coach
  • Account Hygiene: Keep every account organized with consistent naming conventions, UTM tracking, and pixel and conversion tracking, working with Tech & Automations to keep data clean
  • Campaign Audits: Run recurring audits of active accounts to catch structural, targeting, or budget inefficiencies before they compound
  • Recruiting Ads: Post and manage paid recruiting ads when new roles go live

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Daily Monitoring: Check spend, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and ROAS daily across all active campaigns
  • Optimization: Pause, scale, or adjust campaigns against the performance thresholds the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets, without waiting to be told
  • Platform Awareness: Track Meta, Google, and YouTube platform and policy changes that could affect active campaigns, and flag anything the Senior Paid Ads Coach needs to know
  • Curriculum Flagging: Flag when a platform change is coming or occurs
  • Early Warning: Flag underperformance or tracking issues the same day, before they burn budget
  • Occasional Holiday/Weekend Coverage: During an active launch, monitor campaigns as needed during occasional holidays or weekends when the rest of the team is not working. In exchange, we’ll provide flexibility to adjust your schedule and make up that time during the week
  • Industry Research: Run ongoing competitive and industry analysis to surface emerging trends, new ad formats, and growth opportunities

Reporting

  • Recurring Reporting: Build and maintain the weekly and campaign-level performance reports for the Senior Paid Ads Coach and leadership
  • Budget Pacing: Track spend against planned budget for every active campaign so nothing overspends or underspends without a reason

Creative Coordination

  • Creative Briefs: Write the creative briefs for new ad concepts, partnering with Brand & Creative to shape assets and call out iteration opportunities as results come in
  • Creative Requests: Partner with Brand & Creative and Funnels teams to get ad creative, copy, and landing pages built, tested, and refreshed on schedule
  • Test Planning: Contribute ideas to the A/B testing plan for creative, audiences, and landing page experience, based on what you are seeing in the accounts
  • Creative Testing: Run the creative and audience tests the Senior Paid Ads Coach prioritizes, and report back what won and why

Content Quality Support

  • Curriculum Recommendations and QA: Do a first-pass review of new ad-related training material, checking for accuracy and consistency with current platform behavior and ensure what’s in the training aligns with what’s working and relevant
  • Refresh Tracking: Keep a running list of course content that needs a refresh based on platform or strategy changes

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 2 to 4 years of hands-on paid media buying, building and managing campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube). Can confidently manage a 7-figure annual ad budget across multiple platforms.
  • Tracking & Attribution: Comfortable with pixels, UTMs, and conversion tracking, and knows how to troubleshoot when the numbers do not add up
  • Analytical: Comfortable working in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Excel, and can read a report and know what to do next, not just pull the numbers
  • Detail & Organization: Manages multiple active campaigns and deadlines at once without letting tracking, optimization, or reporting standards slip
  • Communication: Flags issues and opportunities early rather than waiting to be asked, and can explain what happened in a campaign in plain language.
  • Fast moving: Advocates for the businesses’ best interest, including making budget decisions, optimization decisions, and creative decisions. Swiftly moves and takes action based on data and not feelings.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Additional platform experience: TikTok, Reddit, Spotify, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads, App Ads
  • Experience supporting A/B testing and optimization across audiences, creative, bidding, and landing pages
  • Experience running lead-gen ads for challenges, webinars, or launches specifically
  • Experience in online education, coaching, or membership businesses
  • Experience working with agency partners or cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Google Ads and other platform certifications

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

  • Owns the Account: You treat ad spend like it is your own money and you do not need someone looking over your shoulder to catch a problem. When something is off, you have usually already found it and started working the fix.
  • Fast and Disciplined: You move quickly on optimizations but you do not skip the reporting and tracking hygiene to get there. Speed that breaks attribution is not speed, because nobody can tell what worked afterward.
  • Initiates: You see a trend or a problem before anyone points it out, and you act on it. You read the platform release notes, you notice a format change before it shows up in your results, and you have a point of view about what to do with it.
  • Comfortable Inside a Lane: Strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds sit with the Senior Paid Ads Coach. You can run hard inside those thresholds without either overstepping them or waiting to be told what to do next.
  • Bothered by Bad Data: An untagged campaign, a broken pixel, or a number that does not reconcile sits with you until it is resolved. You would rather stop and get it right than publish a report you do not fully trust.
  • Plain-Spoken About Performance: You can explain what happened in an account to someone who does not buy media, without hiding a bad week behind jargon. Good news and bad news travel at the same speed.

EMPLOYMENT TYPE & OUTSIDE WORK

This is a full-time role, and we're looking for people who are all in. That means this is the work, not one of a few things you're juggling.

To protect focus and prevent burnout, we don't permit outside work or side gigs for full-time team members. If you currently run a business or have a commitment you're not looking to step away from, this likely isn't the right fit, and that's okay. We'd rather be upfront so we're aligned from the start.

We've found the people who thrive here are the ones whose energy and vision are fully on this business. That focus is what helps the whole team win.

Please note: applicants must reside within the US to be considered.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Base Salary: $65,000-$75,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Flexible PTO: Flexible time off after 6 months, plus company-wide holidays
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) with employer match after 6 months
  • Profit-Sharing 401(k): Employer-funded contributions based on tenure and other plan factors, with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks fully paid to the primary provider and 4 weeks fully paid to the secondary provider (eligibility based on length of service)
  • Wardrobe Stipend: $2,000 first-year bonus for business attire
  • Home Office Stipend: $500 to create a productive remote workspace
  • Annual Incentive Trip: Fully-paid team trip to a bucket-list destination
  • Wellness Benefit: Georgia-based employees receive monthly access to our private Wellness Center (gym, sauna, and cold plunge). Employees outside Georgia receive a monthly wellness stipend (up to $50 per month) through reimbursement.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.


Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.


What we offer

  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

jobs.title: Horizon3: Staff Technical Support Engineer (Web App)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US, Remote
URL: http://horizon3.ai

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

  • Investigate complex failures across the entire stack. A single case might take you from Kubernetes pod scheduling, through container networking, into cloud IAM permissions, and into our application logs in Datadog. You own the investigation end to end.

  • Be the technical bridge between customers and engineering. You'll translate customer-reported symptoms into actionable bug reports with reproduction steps, logs, and root cause hypotheses. When engineering ships a fix, you verify it actually solves the problem in the customer's environment.

  • Build tooling and automation. If you're doing something manually more than twice, you build a tool. We need someone who writes Python scripts, builds internal dashboards, automates data collection from Zendesk and Jira, and creates runbooks that make the whole team more effective.

  • Drive systemic improvements. You'll spot patterns across tickets that point to product gaps, documentation holes, or infrastructure reliability issues. You bring the data, make the case, and work with engineering and product to fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

  • Go deep on web application security. Our platform now does web app pentesting. You need to understand common vulnerability classes (OWASP top 10), how web scanners work, and how to explain findings and their implications to customers who range from security experts to IT generalists.

  • Mentor the team and raise the technical bar. You'll help junior and senior engineers develop their troubleshooting skills, create training content, and establish patterns for how the team approaches complex investigations.

What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 8+ years of hands-on technical experience. The title on your resume matters less than what you've actually done. We'll take an SRE who built incident response tooling, a backend developer who ran production infrastructure, or a support engineer who can write real code and read Terraform.

  • Strong Linux fundamentals. You're comfortable on a command line, can troubleshoot a hung process on RHEL, understand SELinux, and don't need a GUI to be productive.

  • Container and Kubernetes experience. You've deployed and troubleshot containerized workloads. You know the difference between a CrashLoopBackOff and an ImagePullBackOff and what to do about each.

  • Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You understand IAM, networking (VPCs, security groups, firewalls), and have worked with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) -- not just reading plans, but writing and debugging them when provisioning fails.

  • GraphQL and web application fluency. Our API is GraphQL. You can trace a request from a React frontend through the GraphQL layer to the backend, interpret query/mutation responses (including partial errors in a 200), and debug auth flows, CORS issues, and network failures using browser dev tools.

  • Database fundamentals. You can write SQL to investigate data issues, understand relational and NoSQL concepts, and ideally have exposure to graph databases -- our product maps attack paths and relationships that are naturally graph-shaped.

  • Scripting ability in Python and Bash. You've built automation that other people actually use, not just one-off scripts for yourself.

  • Observability tool experience (Datadog preferred). You can search logs, build queries, read traces, and correlate signals across services to find where something broke.

  • Strong communication skills. You'll write to customers, file bugs for engineering, and present findings to product. Each audience needs a different approach and you adjust naturally.

Big pluses:

  • Background in cybersecurity, pentesting, or AppSec. Understanding of common exploit classes, vulnerability assessment, and security tooling.

  • Experience with web application security. Familiar with XSS, SQLi, SSRF, auth bypass, IDOR, and how WAFs and CDNs affect security testing.

  • Active Directory experience. Many of our customers' environments are AD-heavy, and NodeZero tests AD attack paths (password audits, credential attacks, privilege escalation). Understanding AD architecture, GPOs, trusts, and common misconfigurations is a real advantage.

  • Full-stack development experience. You've shipped production code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go.

  • Deep graph database experience (Neo4j or similar). Our attack path data is graph-native -- if you can write Cypher queries and understand graph traversal, you'll hit the ground running.

  • Certifications (AWS SA Pro, CKA, RHCE, OSCP, or similar). Not required, but signals self-direction and depth.

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR). Useful given our customer base.

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $117,000 - $145,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.description:

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required

  • 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.
  • Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.
  • Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.
  • Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.
  • You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.
  • Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have

  • Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.
  • Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.
  • Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.
  • Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.
  • Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

  • A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.
  • Monthly payments in USD

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.

About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries.  Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience.

We are a certified B Corp that formed in the US in 2016 and have been growing globally since then. We expanded to Australia in 2022, acquired Solar Service Guys in Australia in 2025, and have opened up a new talent hub in India in 2026. Be part of the "First Wave" experience! You would be a founding member of our India team, helping us build a brand-new hub from the ground up. 

The Job

As a Senior Salesforce Developer – Field Service at Omnidian, you will design, develop, and optimize Salesforce Field Service solutions that power our technician experience and field operations. You'll leverage the latest Salesforce AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve technician productivity, and enhance customer experiences while building scalable, secure, and maintainable platform solutions.

You are a hands-on Salesforce engineer with deep expertise in Field Service who embraces AI-assisted development and modern engineering practices. You'll partner closely with Product, Operations, Customer Experience, and Engineering teams to deliver intelligent solutions that improve scheduling, dispatching, work execution, and operational efficiency.


What You'll Do

Salesforce Field Service Development

AI-Driven Engineering

Platform Engineering

Integrations & Automation

  • Design reliable automation that supports scheduling, dispatching, technician workflows, and customer communications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational processes through intelligent automation and platform enhancements.

  • You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while keeping user experience and operational efficiency at the center of your decisions.

  • You mentor teammates, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve how software is built and delivered.

Experience You’ll Need

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Experience building AI-powered technician assistants, intelligent scheduling, or knowledge retrieval solutions.

jobs.description:
