About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

 

What are we hiring for?

The systems that run millions of businesses.

Every month, 2.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window - with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Build and ship features in Node.js / Go services that sit on real production paths — your code handles live traffic, not toy problems

  • Own well-scoped services and components end to end: code, tests, rollout, and monitoring

  • Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores — writing queries, adding indexes, and learning why the schema looks the way it does

  • Get hands-on with queues, caches, and rate limiters — the building blocks of every system here

  • Ship Vue 3 UIs that consume your own APIs — clean components, sane state management, and realtime updates that don't flicker or drift

  • Write design docs for your features and defend them in review — clear thinking, honest trade-offs

  • Join the on-call rotation with backup from senior engineers — incidents are where the deepest learning happens

  • Ask questions relentlessly, absorb feedback from code reviews, and level up fast

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of backend engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Node.js, Go, or a comparable language — and the drive to go deep in ours

  • Working knowledge of queues or async processing — you've used Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar, and want to master delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure

  • Genuine interest in distributed systems — you understand the basics (idempotency, retries, consistency trade-offs) and are hungry to learn the rest by building

  • Hands-on with Redis or another cache/in-memory store, even at small scale

  • Comfortable with SQL or NoSQL databases — you can model data, write efficient queries, and reason about indexes

  • Proficient in Vue 3 or a similar modern frontend framework — solid component design and real experience with state management (Pinia, Vuex, or equivalent)

  • You write tests as a habit and can put your design thinking into a clear doc

  • AI-native builder — you code with agents daily and are pushing to get accurate, production-quality output from them

Technical Environment:

  • Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Tailwind

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse

  • Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

Why This Role

Most engineers spend years at companies where "scale" means a few hundred requests per second — and never find out what they're capable of.

Here, the systems are the teacher. Every design decision has a visible consequence at billions of events a month. Every incident is a masterclass. You'll sit in architecture reviews with staff engineers debating storage engines and consistency models — and within a year, you'll be contributing to those debates, not just watching them.

If you optimize your career for learning velocity, there is no faster track than this.

 

On AI

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build - and we expect you to be hungry for it.

You already code with agents daily. You're learning what they're good at, where they hallucinate, and how to get accurate, tested, slop-free code out of them fast. You treat AI as a multiplier on your learning speed, not a substitute for understanding.

If you're still copy-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.

What you're built for

  • You're deeply curious — you don't stop at "it works," you need to know why it works

  • You read post-mortems and system-design write-ups for fun, not because someone assigned them

  • You've built things beyond your job description — side projects, internal tools, that one system you rewrote because the old one bothered you

  • You take feedback like a gift: code review comments make your next PR better, every time

  • When something breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

What Success looks like

  • You own a service or component that the team trusts you on completely

  • You're a dependable on-call engineer — you've debugged real incidents and shipped the fixes

  • Your design docs have gone from "reviewed heavily" to "approved with nits"

  • Senior engineers pull you into harder problems — because you've earned it

  • You're visibly on the path to SDE-3, and everyone around you knows it

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • You've contributed to a messaging, automation, or event-driven system — at any scale

  • Side projects or open-source work that shows you build because you can't not build

    • Build scalable monitoring and alerting systems that track identity resolution health and enable proactive issue detection

    • Conduct deep discovery using data analysis, customer interviews, and competitive research to uncover opportunities for improvement

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Position Summary

As the Director of Partner Operations, you will lead the operational engine that powers our global partner ecosystem. You will be responsible for building and optimizing processes, tools, and programs that support all partner types—resell, referral, delivery, technology, MSP, and cloud marketplaces.

You will collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Channel Sales, Alliances, Product, Finance, and Marketing to ensure our partner strategy is supported by scalable infrastructure and clear performance metrics.

Please note: while this is a remote role, we are seeking candidates based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to support close collaboration with our West Coast channel leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Operations Strategy
    • Lead the development and execution of partner operations strategy aligned to business growth goals.
    • Design and implement scalable processes to support a diverse partner ecosystem, including resellers, referral partners, GSIs, SIs, MSPs, ISVs, and cloud marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Azure).
    • Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure partner performance, pipeline, and influence.
  • Sales Operations Alignment
    • Partner with Sales Ops and RevOps to integrate partner data into core sales systems (Salesforce, PRM, BI tools).
    • Optimize lead-to-cash processes for indirect routes, including partner deal registration, attribution, and compensation.
  • Partner Program & Enablement
    • Support ongoing evolution of Ping’s partner program, tiers, incentives, and benefits.
    • Ensure operational support for onboarding, certification, and enablement workflows.
    • Track partner participation and compliance with program requirements.
  • Technology & Systems Ownership
    • Own or influence tools that support partner lifecycle (e.g., PRM, Salesforce, LMS, partner portals).
    • Work with IT and vendors to enhance partner system capabilities and integrations.
  • Cross-functional Leadership
    • Serve as the key operations point of contact for Partner Sales, Alliances, and Executive Leadership.
    • Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to support GTM alignment with technology and cloud partners.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Channel/Partner Operations, or similar roles in B2B SaaS environments.
  • Deep understanding of partner ecosystems including VARs, GSIs, ISVs, MSPs, and hyperscalers.

jobs.title: Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement.  This position requires residency in the greater Portland area.


What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

 

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

 

Production & Volume Growth

  • Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals
  • Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production
  • Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality
  • Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

 

Credit & Deal Structuring

  • Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers

Training & Dealer Development

  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills
  • Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

  • Own the technical sale in strategic Enterprise accounts ($200K–$1M+ ACV), partnering with Enterprise AEs from first engagement through signed MSA

  • Deep MEDDPICC or MEDDIC fluency — not just familiarity. You use it to qualify, coach your AE, and run retrospectives on lost deals. Explicit MEDDPICC methodology experience is strongly preferred.

THE ROLE

The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is responsible for overseeing Glossier’s purchasing strategy, vendor relationships, and supply chain operations to acquire goods and services cost-effectively. This role works closely with finance, logistics, and commercial as a trusted, strategic partner enabling value and flexibility to support broader business goals. 

You will be responsible for all processes and budget with expectations for delivering both short-term and long-term priorities and plans. You will work closely with our internal teams to lead and develop a first-class supply chain that supports Glossier’s growth and expansion, both domestically and internationally. Omni-channel beauty industry experience is preferred with a preference for candidates who have previously worked in fragrance, make-up and/or skincare.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DELIVERABLES

  • Strategic Procurement Planning: Develop and implement procurement plans to support new development and existing portfolio products, ensuring finished goods meet operational and financial goals.
  • Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function to enhance efficiency and reduce costs, lead times, and MOQs.
  • Supplier Network Strategy & Qualification: Identify and qualify new suppliers, establishing new vendor partnerships while maintaining current vendor connectivity rooted in quality, transparency, and efficiency.
  • Material Replenishment Strategy: Lead efforts to develop, implement, and manage alternate material replenishment methods that increase inventory turns year over year while supporting 100% customer on-time delivery and lead-time reduction.

  • Order Tracking & Expediting: Coordinate and track open order updates across all vendor partners to remain informed of delays or potential shipment issues.
  • Day-to-Day Administration & Master Data: Manage PO execution, master data accuracy, BOM creation/management, supplier records, and spend tracking.

KEY INGREDIENTS

    • Deep expertise leading end-to-end global supply chain, procurement, sourcing, and quality operations in an omni-channel environment.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US

About the role

Descript's script-based editing features are at the heart of why creators trust us for their highest-stakes content. Product launches. Client interviews. Marketing campaigns. Content that represents them to their audiences.

As Lead Product Manager of the Narrative Editing team, you'll own how users capture, edit, and perfect their stories. You'll shape the script-first editing that makes video as simple as a document, the recording and writing tools that let users create without leaving Descript, and the AI regeneration features that make edits feel seamless and natural.

This is an opportunity to shape features that professional creators depend on while working with cutting-edge AI, a product users love, and a small, collaborative team where your impact is immediate and visible.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their creative goals, and the evolving AI video landscape — and use those insights to guide the editor roadmap
  • Bring Descript's taste for great video into interactions and defaults, so creators naturally produce polished, professional work
  • Continuously expand our editing capabilities with frontier AI technology by partnering with our AI Research team, launching features like video regeneration and automatic speaker identification
  • Own the recording, script generation, and translation flows that help users achieve their end-to-end video workflows directly in Descript
  • Ensure Descript scales reliably for larger teams and more complex workflows

Who you are

  • You’ve built deceptively powerful tools: You have 5 or more years of product management experience shipping creative tools or workflow products that feel simple enough for everyone, but scale to handle sophisticated use cases. You are a systems-minded product thinker who excels at designing intuitive experiences for complex, end-to-end workflows.
  • You start with the customer: Plenty of “AI products” start with the technology and they all suck. You care deeply about understanding customers, and have experience in doing customer discovery and defining features that solve real problems.
  • You are a fog sculptor: There are aspects to our editor and its design that do not have real competitors yet. The product intuition and design conventions have not been decided. You are attracted to ambiguous problems, know how to ask smart questions, and translate ideas into action.
  • You care about craft: Our product is not a hype machine that runs on empty promises and vaporware. We think our product will be successful because people love to use it. That means you sweat the details. But without the sweat, because you aren’t stressed out.

So, just want to drop a hint early on. Also, the sense of humor is important because even though we take our work seriously it’s still just, like, video creation and editing. We aren’t flying rockets into space so let’s all have a good time.

The base salary range for this role is $225,000 - $290,000. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital).

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.
  • Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.
  • HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.
  • Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.
  • PBP, ER & Programs Support.
    • PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.
    • Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.
    • Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.
  • Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.
  • Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.
  • Country Expertise.  Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.

You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

  • Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst

  • Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

  • Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained

  • Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site

  • Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed

  • Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

  • Vendor requirements and acceptance: write the requirements, evaluate against live flights and runs, and hold vendors to what they ship

Minimum qualifications

  • Have engineered autonomous or sensing systems in the field (drones, ground robots, automated vehicles, or RF, radar or optical detection sensors): selected, integrated or secured them for an operation other people relied on, and verified what they actually do against real targets or runs rather than a datasheet

  • Have integrated systems you did not build (vendor APIs, SDKs, appliances, machine and sensor telemetry) into a platform that outlives any one of them

  • Read and review code, design the data systems behind security tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

  • Have done this work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

  • Have designed inside a regulatory or safety constraint (aviation, spectrum, privacy, machine safety or similar) and can show the decision it drove

  • Own a domain end to end: set the approach, carry it through with vendors, site operators, partners and authorities, and run it as something people depend on every day

Preferred qualifications

  • Remote pilot certification (for example FAA Part 107) and experience flying beyond visual line of sight under a waiver or exemption

  • Experience with counter-drone (counter-UAS) detection, airspace surveillance or air traffic data systems

  • Experience running a robot, drone or automated-vehicle fleet in an industrial, logistics or data center setting: fleet management, mission planning, safety cases

  • Experience securing embedded, operational technology or robotic systems: device identity, network segmentation, update control, logging

  • Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, colocation or GPU cloud operators

  • Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Carrot: Sr. IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 

Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
  • Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
  • Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
  • Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
  • Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
  • Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
  • Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
  • Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
  • Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
  • Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
  • Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
  • Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You

You likely have:

  • 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access
  • Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration
  • Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams
  • A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts
  • Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations
  • Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

Why This Role Matters

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

  • Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.
 

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;
  • Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;
  • Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;
  • Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;
 

Key Requirements

  • You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)
  • Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence
  • A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.
  • You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;
  • Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;
  • You have security or risk control experience as a plus.
  • You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Mortgage Loan Officer Live Transfer Closer. Inbound Purchase Leads

This is a closing role, plain and simple. We hand you live, pre-screened purchase leads. Your job is to convert them.

No cold calling. No chasing. No building a pipeline from scratch. When a consumer who's ready to buy gets transferred to you, you pick up, build trust fast, and get them to the finish line. If you're a closer who's been stuck doing everything except closing, this is the seat where you just do what you're best at.

But let's be clear about what this role actually rewards: conversion. Not activity, not hours logged, not how many calls you can make. We're measuring one thing, how many of the good leads we give you turn into funded loans. If you close, we keep feeding you. If you don't, this isn't the fit.

Who wins in this seat:

  • You close what's in front of you. You've got a track record of turning leads into funded deals. You know your conversion rate, and you're proud of it. That number is what gets you this job.

  • You build trust fast. These are purchase leads comparing multiple offers. The LO who wins isn't the one who talks fastest or pushes hardest. It's the one the borrower trusts in the first two minutes. Warmth and competence close more live transfers than pressure ever will.

  • You own the process. From the first call to structuring the file to delivering confidence to a nervous buyer, you know mortgages well enough to handle a live consumer in real time without fumbling.

  • You move fast and stay sharp. Live transfers reward people who are responsive, organized, and ready. Leads are an opportunity, not a guarantee. You treat every one like it matters.
About the leads: Live transfers are the headline, but they’re not the only fuel. You’ll also work our online leads and AI-matched leads, which reward a different muscle: fast first contact and disciplined follow-up until the borrower picks up. Killers do both. They close what’s handed to them live, and they don’t let an online lead go cold because it didn’t answer the first time.

What we provide:

Live, pre-screened purchase leads from consumers ready to compare offers. You're their closer. Real support to help you convert, including a national team of about 50 producing LOs and a Slack where questions get answered in about five minutes, even nights and weekends. Every purchase deal is also a chance to build a relationship with the agent on the transaction, turning one closed loan into an ongoing referral source. 50+ lenders, a full broker product shelf, and no income caps. If you can close, we can keep you fed.

We've been doing this 20+ years (NMLS 4190). Our CEO and President still fund loans every day.

The honest part: this role lives and dies on conversion. We give you real opportunities. What you do with them is on you. If you're a proven closer who just wants quality leads and the support to fund them, this is your seat. If your close rate isn't where it should be, this role will expose that fast.

Our process includes a short assessment that helps us understand how you're wired to close, so we can support you the right way.

Ready to turn live leads into funded loans? Apply and let's talk.

This is a remote position.

At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in a diverse, inclusive culture centered on great people practices, learning opportunities, and fun! As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

This role is based in the US and operates as a key member of a globally distributed marketing team, collaborating closely with colleagues across the US, CAD, UK, and EMEA to deliver consistent, high-performing digital programs at scale.

Job Overview

The Associate Product Marketing Manager, GRC will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for select products in Mitratech's GRC portfolio. This role will focus on positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement, working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Marketing. We're looking for a hands-on marketer who can own defined projects, turn complex product and market information into clear, customer-facing messaging, and collaborate effectively across teams. The ideal candidate is curious, proactive, organized, and comfortable using data and AI tools to make marketing work more efficient.

Launch & GTM Execution

AI-Enabled Workflows

jobs.title: Elavate: UGC Coordinator
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://elavate.teamtailor.com

About Elavate

Elavate is a multi-collagen supplement brand for women 40+, built around the changes that come with perimenopause and menopause. Our founder, Alex Philip, started it after getting fed up buying overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen for his mum.

Since launching in 2024 we've become one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK, with over 35,000 five-star reviews. We launched in the US in 2026, and it's now our biggest focus for growth.

Our growth runs on video ads: UGC, influencer and celebrity talent content, made with an in-house team of creative strategists and video editors. The better the creators and the content, the faster we grow. That's where you come in.

The role

Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. You're the person in the middle who makes the content happen: finding the right creators, briefing and storyboarding every script, running influencer and high-production shoots with our agency partners, and making sure every video that comes back is right.

You'll handle two kinds of content:

  • UGC: creators film themselves at home from our briefs, so the brief has to do all the directing

  • Influencer and high-production shoots: the two go hand in hand. We film well-known influencers and TV personalities with a professional crew, at a location picked for the look, with lighting, a teleprompter and make-up. These shoots make our long-form direct response ads, plus the hooks, product shots and B-roll that go with them

You'll work across both markets, the UK and the US, alongside our founder and creative team.

This is a communications, creators and systems role. You want to be in it every day: talking to creators, getting content made and getting deals done. Strategy experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll own

Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US

  • Source new UGC creators every week, mostly women 40+ who come across as natural, expressive and believable on camera

  • Vet properly before anyone gets a brief: watch their content, judge their delivery, setting and camera skills, and only put forward people you'd bet on

  • Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal

  • Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)

  • Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent

Build and run our creator database

  • Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week

  • Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them

  • Keep a bench of proven creators we can rebook at short notice

  • Keep an eye on creative performance in Motion, so you know which creators and videos are winning and can find, rebook and brief more like them

  • Run product sendouts: get product out as soon as a deal is signed and confirm it's arrived

Brief and storyboard every script

  • Turn finished scripts from our strategists into briefs a creator can film without guessing: a scene-by-scene storyboard, B-roll, visual direction, setting, outfits and props

  • Lock every brief before it goes out: one final version, a clear deadline, a reference video and links you've tested

  • Run a quick test clip before each full batch, so problems get caught before they cost us a refilm

Coordinate our influencer and high-production shoots

  • Work hand in hand with our content agency and shoot production agency: they run the day-to-day logistics on our crewed shoots, you make sure nothing gets missed

  • Run the threads with agents and talent managers on scheduling, call times and riders

  • Own the details: locations, props, product on set and a checklist to the crew before every shoot

Check content and get it live

  • Check every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming: every hook, every section, resolution, lighting, framing and product shots

  • Post a written verdict for the team on what's good and exactly what's wrong (a thumbs-up isn't a check), so refilm calls get made fast

  • Once content is approved, get sign-off from the talent side, secure whitelisting access and hand clean files to our editors

How we work (read this part properly)

This is what makes or breaks the role, so we're being specific.

  • You're very responsive and active on Slack. This is one of the most important parts of the role. When you're online, messages get a reply in minutes, not hours, even if it's just "on it, back to you by 4pm". Slow replies are how things slip and shoots go wrong.

  • You own it end to end. Some of our shoots cost thousands, so you treat every one like it's your own money. Nobody checks behind you: if something's about to fall through the cracks, you catch it first.

  • You confirm, you don't assume. A CC isn't a confirmation. When a time, location or script changes, you confirm it directly with every person involved.

  • You take in the full context. You listen to the whole voice note, watch the whole Loom and read the whole thread before you act. Then you ask the questions that matter.

  • You close loops. Sign-offs, follow-ups and tracker updates don't sit with you. If something's blocked, you flag it before anyone has to chase you.

  • You turn up. Every call, on time and prepared.

  • You ship, then improve. A solid brief out today beats a beautiful one next week.

  • You build systems. If you're doing the same manual task twice, you build a workflow for it (Notion, templates, AI) so the third time is faster.

  • You're there when it's live. On shoot days and urgent threads, you jump online outside your normal hours if something needs doing.

  • You take feedback well. Direct feedback, no ego, acted on the same day.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • 2+ years in UGC, creator or influencer coordination, at a DTC brand, a UGC or performance creative agency, or an influencer or talent agency

  • Fluent written and spoken English: you'll talk to UK and US creators, agents and talent managers all day, so your messages are quick, clear and polite

  • You can read a video script and storyboard it scene by scene, with B-roll and visual direction (we'll ask you to show us)

  • An eye for talent: you can tell from a creator's content whether they'll work in a direct response ad

  • A strong negotiator who enjoys the people side: you get good rates and the right terms, and creators still want to work with you again

  • You know performance marketing metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS), can read an ad account audit, and have used Motion or a similar tool to review creative performance

  • Confident in Frame.io and Notion

  • Seriously organised: calendars, trackers and checklists are your thing, and nothing gets lost with you

  • AI-first: you use tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to work faster, and you know how to build simple workflows that save the team time

  • Sharp and quick: you pick things up first time and don't need to be shown twice

Nice to have

  • Creative strategy or direct response experience: writing scripts and hooks, or turning ad data into new concepts

  • Experience with health, wellness, beauty or supplement brands

  • You've coordinated crewed shoots or worked with talent agents and managers

  • You've built something of your own: a side business, a creator account or an agency

Pay, hours and perks

  • $30,000 USD a year (about $2,500 a month), full-time, as an independent contractor

  • 3-month review against clear goals, with a pay step-up when you hit them, plus clear pay tiers so you always know what the next level takes

  • Remote from Latin America, with core hours agreed before you start that overlap the UK afternoon and the US working day

  • 28 days paid time off a year

  • Work directly with our founder and senior creative team, on content with well-known UK and US talent

  • A path into creative strategy if that's where you want to grow

How to apply

Apply with your CV. In a short note or cover letter, tell us about the best creator you've ever found and why they worked. Start it with the word "storyboard" so we know you've read this far.

Our process:

  1. Screening call

  2. Interview

  3. Paid test task, based on the real job

  4. Final interview

We move fast. If this sounds like you, apply today.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elavate-ugc-coordinator

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform.   • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

  • Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you’ll be great at this!)
  • Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
  • Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day

We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.

Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

  • Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.

In this job, you will:

  • Manage all current customer data
  • Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
  • Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall

  • Highly articulate, ability to communicate effectively both when speaking and writing
  • Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

Remote Worldwide (Working Hours East Coast Time 9am to 6pm)

Grüns is scaling fast, and our People team needs a hands-on partner who can coach managers and run the operational engine at the same time. You'll be the first line of support for managers and employees on policy, performance, and growth, while owning payroll, leaves, benefits, and the employee lifecycle end to end. You'll step in during a major Q1 2027 systems transition, protecting talent density, keeping pay and compliance airtight, and freeing our People leadership to focus on strategy.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the first point of contact for managers and employees on policy, performance, corrective feedback, and growth
  • Coach managers on feedback, documentation, and follow-ups, with hands-on support through performance and termination situations that keep talent density high and legal risk low
  • Run People Team 1:1s and exit interviews for Levels 1 and 2, and surface culture themes, flight risks, and training gaps for our quarterly People Pulse report
  • Administer leaves (FMLA, ADA, state, STD, parental) and accommodation requests from start to finish, and oversee workers' comp claims
  • Own payroll accuracy across HQ, field, and international teams by resolving complications directly with our partners and tracking every issue to closure
  • Own benefits administration end to end: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, carrier coordination, renewals, and clear employee communication
  • Own onboarding and offboarding, so every new hire starts with complete paperwork and correct pay, and every exit closes out cleanly on final pay, benefits notices, and access
  • Keep employee data clean (levels, titles, departments, managers, compensation) so comp, survey, and headcount decisions are always backed by accurate data
  • Support employees through our Q1 2027 payroll, benefits, and retirement platform changes
  • Turn repeat work into AI-supported workflows, and know when AI shouldn't be involved

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 5+ years scaling HR support, ideally on a coordinator to HRBP to HR Generalist track in a fast-growing consumer or DTC company
  • Has hands-on payroll administration experience
  • Has run leaves (FMLA, ADA, state leaves, STD, parental) and workers' comp end to end
  • Has administered benefits: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, and open enrollment
  • Has a track record in employee relations and manager coaching, including performance documentation and terminations
  • Has handled sensitive employee situations and exits with discretion and good judgment
  • Has working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, COBRA, E-Verify, and multi-state leave and final pay laws
  • Bonus: payroll or HRIS migration or acquisition integration experience, and Paylocity experience

Approach to the role:

  • You bring a customer service mindset: you acknowledge fast, focus on solutions, and can't rest until every loop is closed
  • You're detail-obsessed about anything that touches someone's pay
  • You treat every interaction as if it could land on the front page of the NY Times
  • You build real relationships and stay culture-aligned while making decisions in the best interest of Grüns
  • You have extreme ownership and self-motivation, so micromanagement isn't needed because you're always 10 steps ahead
  • You use AI to protect your focus for thoughtful people partnership

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

 

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

 

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!
